contamination_notes.location: 沒有被統合分析講清楚的部分
contamination_notes.issue: OR 1.054 is paraphrased as a 5.4% increase in risk; an odds ratio supports an odds interpretation, subject to confirming the predictor unit.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Write that recurrence odds increased by about 5.4% per confirmed model unit, or retain OR 1.054 without conversion.

contamination_notes.issue: The source reports levothyroxine replacement but the explainer strengthens this to lifelong replacement without an explicit duration basis.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: State only that 2.4% required levothyroxine replacement unless permanence is directly documented.

contamination_notes.issue: I-squared of zero is described too strongly as showing consistency and absence of an extreme-study effect despite only three quantitative datasets.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: State that no statistical heterogeneity was detected and retain the small-study limitation.
